Privacy Notice

Information you choose to share

This notice explains how Almajdoub Dispatch handles information submitted through the Founder Waitlist and the contact email shown on this website.

Information collected

The Founder Waitlist asks for the carrier legal or trade name, MC or USDOT number, email address, equipment type, number of trucks, and telephone number. The form also records the privacy-notice version acknowledged, a registration reference, the receipt time, and the waitlist status. It does not request tax, insurance, banking, driver, load, or location documents.

Cloudflare Turnstile processes a spam-verification token and may receive network information needed to validate the challenge.

How information is used

Registration details are used to administer the waitlist, prevent duplicate authority submissions, contact the carrier about its registration, and support manual eligibility and capacity review. A registration is not automated approval, contract acceptance, or service activation. The telephone number is not used by this form to send text messages.

Service providers and storage

The website and request handling use Cloudflare. Waitlist registrations are stored in the Almajdoub Dispatch Supabase database configured in the United States. Access is intended to be limited to authorized project administration. If you contact us by email, Cloudflare Email Routing and Google Gmail may process that message.

Information may be processed in the United States and other locations where those providers operate. Their own privacy and security practices also apply to their services.

Sharing and retention

Almajdoub Dispatch does not sell waitlist registration details. Information is retained only while needed to administer the waitlist and any resulting application, protect the service, resolve disputes, or meet recordkeeping obligations. A fixed deletion period is not stated here.

Your requests

You may ask to access, correct, or delete registration information by writing to contact@almajdoubdispatch.com. Do not attach tax, identity, driver, banking, insurance, Rate Confirmation, POD, shipment, or location records. Some records may need to be retained for security, dispute, or recordkeeping purposes.

Changes and contact

This notice applies to the Founder Waitlist described above. It does not describe a document-upload, payment, tracking, SMS, or AI-processing service. For a privacy question, use contact@almajdoubdispatch.com.

Notice version: 2026-11-08-v1 · Effective date: November 8, 2026
